title: Structural unit coefficient composition
statement: Let f:Y→X and g:Z→Y be scheme morphisms. Define coefficientUnit, coeff and invImageComp as in [lem-pc-coefficient-unit-composition, def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Let e=pullbackObjUnitIso f. Then inverseImage(g)(coefficientUnit(f,O_X)) followed by coeff(g)(e.hom followed by the structural unit map for g) equals invImageComp(g,f) at the forgotten O_X followed by coeff(g followed by f) of its structural unit map. This is a sheaf morphism equality without cohomology, affine bases, degrees or cartesian hypotheses.

proof.text: Apply the composite abelian pullback/pushforward adjunction. Naturality in the source and target identifies the adjunct of the left-hand side with the forgotten module pullback unit for f followed by pushforward(f) of e.hom and the structural unit for g.

The mate identity unit_conjugateEquiv_symm identifies the adjunct of invImageComp followed by the coefficient map with the forgotten structural map for g followed by f. The module adjunction identity for pullbackObjUnitToUnit replaces unit(f) followed by pushforward(f)(e.hom) with the structural map for f. The remaining equality holds definitionally on every open: both are the composition of the two structure-sheaf maps. Sheaf and natural transformation extensionality finish.

proof_origin.place: Explicit adjunction and Ext argument for the original composition proof step.

lean.statement:
theorem structuralUnitCoefficient_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) :
    (invImage g).map (coefficientUnit f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
        coeff g ((pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom ≫
          SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom) =
      (invImageComp g f).hom.app
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
        coeff (g ≫ f) (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (g ≫ f).toRingCatSheafHom)
